title: Parliament Adopts Reparation Law for 'Enfants de la Creuse' Réunionnais Deportees
detail: French Parliament adopted a reparation law for the 'Enfants de la Creuse', Réunionnais children who were forcibly relocated to mainland France between the 1960s and 1980s. The law provides official state recognition and financial redress for victims of this government-sponsored program that displaced thousands of children from Réunion to underpopulated rural departments.
